summary.what_it_does: The page is the storefront of 数码荔枝, a shop selling licensed software for Win, Mac, iOS and Android at discounted prices in China. It lists featured products such as AdGuard, Microsoft 365 shared plans, EndNote 21, QSpace, PinStack and OneQuick 10, each with a sale price and an end date of 2026-12-31. Categories shown include Mac, Win and mobile platforms, plus a "new arrivals" section. The meta description says the site also offers usage tips and tutorials for multimedia, download/sync, note-taking, office, system optimisation and PDF tools.
notable: Sells discounted genuine (正版) software with prices shown in RMB
Offers a new-user coupon listed as no minimum spend, valid 2024-03-12 to 2024-12-12
Includes usage tips and tutorials alongside product listings
Has a language switcher for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English
caveats: Listed prices are in RMB (¥) and the sale is stated to end 2026-12-31
The new-user coupon shown on the page has an end date of 2024-12-12, so it has likely expired
Microsoft 365 is sold as a shared (拼车) plan, not a standard single licence
